detected_signals.message: Organic search clicks dropped severely by -28.41%. Immediate SEO investigation required (Check seasonality, ranking drops, or indexing issues).
Conversions grew by a healthy 19.92%. Identify which channels drove this and scale.

ai_analysis.summary: Data indicates overall site growth with total sessions increasing by 10.76% and conversions rising by 19.92%, despite a severe drop in organic search visibility where impressions fell 30.86% and clicks declined 28.41%.
wins: Observed fact: Conversions increased by 19.92% (from 487 to 584).
Observed fact: Total sessions grew by 10.76% (from 5,732 to 6,349).
Observed fact: Active users increased by 8.35% (from 5,066 to 5,489).
Observed fact: Pageviews rose by 3.48% (from 8,246 to 8,533).
issues: Observed fact: Google Search Console clicks fell by 28.41% (from 968 to 693).
Observed fact: Google Search Console impressions dropped by 30.86% (from 22,573 to 15,607).
opportunities: Investigate specific traffic channels driving the conversion lift to reallocate marketing budget toward top-performing segments.
Analyze query-level performance in Google Search Console to identify recoverable organic keyword positions.
possible_causes: Potential contributor to conversion growth: Targeted paid campaigns, email marketing, or improved traffic quality from non-organic channels.
Potential contributor to organic search drops: Search ranking declines, algorithmic updates, technical indexing issues, or seasonal decreases in search demand.
recommended_actions: Investigate landing-page and query reports in Google Search Console to isolate which URLs lost the most impressions and clicks.
Review technical SEO health, checking for recent URL changes, robots.txt blocks, or indexing errors.
Segment GA4 conversions by source/medium to confirm which channels produced the conversion increase and evaluate scaling opportunities.
